biography_english:
A Galgastani who serves her clan in battle. She was apprenticed to the Necromancer Nybeth. By studying death in all its forms, she believed it would one day be possible to cheat death entirely.
  When Nybeth set out for Qadriga Fortress to conduct his experiments, she was ordered to stay behind in Krysaro. There she learned that Almorica Castle had fallen, and faced pursuit by the Walister Resistance. She cornered the Resistance forces using the undead creatures at her command, but was defeated upon the arrival of {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que sirve a su clan en batalla. Fue aprendiz del nigromante Nybeth. Al estudiar la muerte en todas sus formas, creia que un dia seria posible burlar la muerte por completo.
  Cuando Nybeth partio a la Fortaleza de Qadriga a realizar sus experimentos, se le ordeno quedarse en Krysaro. Alli supo que el Castillo de Almorica habia caido y enfrento la persecucion de la Resistencia walister. Acorralo a la Resistencia con los no muertos bajo su mando, pero fue derrotada tras la llegada de {hero}.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan. She was the daughter of the Necromancer Nybeth, and studied necromancy under him together with her mother, Cassandra, and sister, Cressida. By studying death in all its forms, she believed it would one day be possible to cheat death entirely.
  She was betrothed to Hektor, head of House Didarro of Coritanae, and their wedding was close at hand. She was killed in a battle against the Walister Resistance at Krysaro.
  Her father Nybeth later resurrected her, but failed to restore her memory, and she attacked her sister Cressida. Her soul was finally set to rest after Resistance forces defeated her once more.
biography_spanish:

  Estaba comprometida con Hektor, lider de la Casa Didarro de Coritanae, y su boda estaba cerca. Fue abatida en batalla contra la Resistencia walister en Krysaro.
  Su padre Nybeth la resucito mas tarde, pero no logro restaurar su memoria, y ella ataco a su hermana Cressida. Su alma descanso tras ser derrotada de nuevo por la Resistencia.

biography_english:
A Walister who once served with the Walister Resistance. She was a spiritualist at the village of Vanan near the border of Almorica, contacting the dead to pass on messages to their kin. Regardless of whether her talents were genuine, Ramidos brought peace to many grieving loved ones. Her father died at an early age, and it is clear that her mother instilled in her a strong sense of compassion.
  She lived in Vanan with her son's family, but all her kin were slain when the village was sacked in the early days of the war. She then joined the Walister Resistance as a spellbinder, specializing in offensive magic.
  She was killed in battle when {hero} arrived at Almorica Castle to free Catiua, who had been kidnapped by Xapan the Mercenary.
biography_spanish:
Una walister que sirvio en la Resistencia walister. Era espiritualista en la aldea de Vanan, cerca de la frontera de Almorica, contactando a los muertos para transmitir mensajes a sus allegados. Sin importar si sus talentos eran reales, Ramidos llevo paz a muchos familiares en duelo. Su padre murio joven, y esta claro que su madre le infundio un gran sentido de compasion.
  Vivia en Vanan con la familia de su hijo, pero todos sus parientes fueron asesinados al ser saqueada la aldea al inicio de la guerra. Se unio a la Resistencia walister como hechicera, especializandose en magia ofensiva.
  Fue abatida en batalla cuando {hero} llego al Castillo de Almorica para liberar a Catiua, secuestrada por Xapan el mercenario.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served her clan in battle. House Apollinaire is a noble family related to former Lord of Coritanae, Count Orlandeau. For generations they have held seats in the House of Nobles, wielding great power throughout the region. Daesi Apollinaire, youngest daughter of the current family head, favored warfare over politics, eventually attaining the rank of commander.
  Galgastani commanders are charged with leading several legions of men, and are second in rank only to high commanders. Daesi was well suited to the role, demonstrating decisive leadership and superlative combat skills.
  She died attempting to fend off {hero}'s assault on Coritanae Keep.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. La Casa Apollinaire es una familia noble emparentada con el antiguo lord de Coritanae, el conde Orlandeau. Por generaciones ocuparon puestos en la Camara de Nobles, ejerciendo gran poder en toda la region. Daesi Apollinaire, la hija menor del actual lider familiar, prefirio la guerra a la politica, alcanzando el rango de comandante.
  Los comandantes galgastani lideran varias legiones y solo los superan los altos comandantes. Daesi encajaba bien en el rol, demostrando liderazgo decisivo y gran destreza en combate.
  Murio al intentar repeler el asalto de {hero} al Fortin de Coritanae.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan.
  She was a necromancer who tampered with the souls of the dead. She studied under the Necromancer Nybeth together with her daughters Moldova and Cressida. They believed that necromancy allowed those who died before their time a chance to fulfill their ambitions.
  Cassandra battled Resistance forces to avenge her daughter Moldova's killing, but was defeated. Nybeth had given her a means to avoid death, but there was no effect, and she perished.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que una vez lucho en los ejercitos de Galgastan.
  Era una nigromante que alteraba las almas de los muertos. Estudio con el nigromante Nybeth junto a sus hijas Moldova y Cressida. Creian que la nigromancia daba a quienes morian antes de tiempo la opcion de cumplir sus ambiciones.
  Cassandra lucho contra fuerzas de la Resistencia para vengar la muerte de su hija Moldova, pero fue derrotada. Nybeth le habia dado un medio para evitar la muerte, pero no tuvo efecto, y perecio.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan.
  She was wife to the Necromancer Nybeth. Cassandra also practiced the dark art of necromancy, and together they instructed their daughters Moldova and Cressida in its ways. They believed that necromancy allowed those who died before their time a chance to fulfill their ambitions.
  Cassandra battled {hero} to avenge her daughter Moldova's killing, but was slain.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que una vez lucho en los ejercitos de Galgastan.
  Era esposa del nigromante Nybeth. Cassandra tambien practicaba el arte oscuro de la nigromancia, y juntos instruyeron a sus hijas Moldova y Cressida en sus vias. Creian que la nigromancia daba a quienes morian antes de tiempo la opcion de cumplir sus ambiciones.
  Cassandra lucho contra {hero} para vengar la muerte de su hija Moldova, pero fue abatida.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan.
  She was wife to the Necromancer Nybeth. Cassandra also practiced the dark art of necromancy, and together they instructed their daughters Moldova and Cressida in its ways. They believed that necromancy allowed those who died before their time a chance to fulfill their ambitions.
  Cassandra battled {hero} to avenge her daughter Moldova's killing, but was slain. Nybeth later raised her as a zombie, but she fell in battle with the Order of {order} once more, and was finally put to rest.

biography_english:
A mage who employed necromancy to compel spirits of the dead to do his bidding. There were sightings of him in Vasque and Asyton, but reports were vague enough to cast doubt on their authenticity. He appears to have been close to the Witch Beelzebuth, but the nature of their relationship is not known.
  He was vanquished after waylaying {hero} on the orders of Beelzebuth. His body was broken in the battle, but his soul may yet live on.
biography_spanish:
Un mago que usaba la nigromancia para obligar a los espiritus de los muertos a obedecerle. Hubo avistamientos suyos en Vasque y Asyton, pero los informes no eran tan confiables. Parece haber sido cercano a la Wicca Beelzebuth, pero se desconoce la naturaleza de su relacion.
  Fue derrotado tras emboscar a {hero} por ordenes de Beelzebuth. Su cuerpo fue destruido en la batalla, pero su alma aun podria perdurar.

biography_english:
A Bakram serving his clan from the shadows. He was tasked with locating an artifact said to be hidden within Lhazan Fortress. While passing near Vasque he was set upon by Ocionne, but he repelled her attack. Learning that Ocionne was a survivor from Vasque, he forced her to lead him to the fortress.
  Reymos is dedicated to the dark art of necromancy. This is rare for one serving the Bakram army, where the Order of Philaha holds much sway. A man of cruel and callous nature, he seeks to bolster the army by reviving the fallen as undead under his command.
biography_spanish:
Un bakram que sirve a su clan desde las sombras. Se le encargo localizar un artefacto que se decia oculto en la Fortaleza de Lhazan. Al pasar cerca de Vasque fue atacado por Ocionne, pero repelio su ataque. Al saber que Ocionne era una superviviente de Vasque, la obligo a guiarlo a la fortaleza.
  Reymos se dedica al arte de la nigromancia. Esto es raro en alguien del ejercito bakram, donde la Orden de Philaha influye mucho. Un hombre de naturaleza cruel e insensible, busca reforzar el ejercito resucitando a los caidos como no muertos bajo su mando.

biography_english:

While passing near Vasque he was set upon by Ocionne, but he repelled her attack. Learning that Ocionne was a survivor from Vasque, he forced her to lead him to the fortress. He later perished in an engagement with Resistance forces there.
  Reymos was dedicated to the dark art of necromancy. This is rare for one serving the Bakram army, where the Order of Philaha holds much sway. A man of cruel and callous nature, he sought to bolster the army by reviving the fallen as undead under his command.

biography_english: A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan. Following the death of Hierophant Balbatos, she escaped to Lhazan Fortress. She spent her days there mourning her comrades killed in battle. Hearing that Resistance forces were marching on the fortress she took up arms against them once more, but was defeated.
biography_spanish: Una galgastani que una vez lucho en los ejercitos de Galgastan. Tras la muerte del jerarca Balbatos, huyo a la Fortaleza de Lhazan. Paso sus dias alli llorando a sus camaradas caidos en batalla. Al saber que la Resistencia marchaba hacia la fortaleza, tomo las armas de nuevo, pero fue derrotada.

biography_english:
A Galgastani serving the armies of Galgastan. She is a sibyl of the Order of Philaha, loyal to Hierophant Balbatos. She was driven off by Resistance forces at the Rhea Boum Aqueduct.
  The Galgastani often assign members of the Order of Philaha as commanders, valuing their respect for discipline and adeptness at inspiring loyalty in soldiers.
biography_spanish:
Una galgastani que sirve en los ejercitos de Galgastan. Es una sibila de la Orden de Philaha, leal al jerarca Balbatos. Fue repelida por la Resistencia en el Acueducto de Rhea Boum.
  Los galgastani suelen asignar miembros de la Orden de Philaha como comandantes, valorando su disciplina y destreza para inspirar lealtad en sus tropas.

biography_english:
One of the golems created by the Wicce Deneb to aid her in her work. Punkin soon emerged as their leader due to her aggressive nature.
  She started life as a pumpkin, but took on human qualities through her strong desire to be treated fairly. Blamed for the banditry carried out at an abandoned village, she fought {hero} and was defeated. In the end she was allowed to take over Deneb's shop. She does brisk business, but has trouble keeping up with payments to Deneb and the other workers. She does appear to be enjoying herself, at least.
  Apparently she was taught the secret of becoming human by a sage she met in the Palace of the Dead, but she will say no more on the subject.
  In her spare time she busies herself growing pumpkins and perfecting her recipe for pumpkin pie.
biography_spanish:
Uno de los golems creados por la Wicce Deneb para ayudarla en su trabajo. Punkin destaco pronto como su lider debido a su caracter agresivo.
  Inicio su vida como calabaza, pero adquirio rasgos humanos por su gran deseo de recibir un trato justo. Culpada por el bandidaje cometido en un pueblo abandonado, lucho contra {hero} y fue derrotada. Al final se le permitio hacerse cargo de la tienda de Deneb. Su negocio prospera, pero le cuesta cumplir los pagos a Deneb y a los otros trabajadores. Al menos parece estar disfrutando.
  Al parecer, un sabio que conocio en el Palacio de los Muertos le indico el secreto para hacerse humana, pero no dice mas del tema.
  En su tiempo libre se dedica a cultivar calabazas y perfeccionar su receta de pastel de calabaza.

biography_english:
An apparition said to prey upon the souls of the dead. She has an enchanting voice that brings death to the living and peace to the dead. Untold numbers of sailors and pirates have perished through Sirene's songs and found solace in her requiems. It is said she appears without fail at the outbreak of war.
  She took possession of the songstress Iuria and brought doom to Port Asyton before being defeated by {hero} at the Pirate's Graveyard.
biography_spanish:
Una aparicion que se dice devora las almas de los muertos. Tiene una voz fascinante que trae la muerte a los vivos y paz a los muertos. Incontables marineros y piratas han perecido con los cantos de Sirene y hallado consuelo en sus requiems. Se dice que aparece sin falta al estallar una guerra.
  Se posesiono de la cantante Iuria y llevo la ruina a Puerto Asyton antes de ser derrotada por {hero} en el Cementerio de Piratas.
